checks.clientGrant: Client owner granted named preparer/reviewer through real existing protected form

checks.setup: Draft, assignment, explicit enrollment and activation; assignment alone did not create a link

checks.suspension: Real suspension clears managed read state; explicit reactivation advances version and restores it without rewriting client grants

checks.handover: Old assignment ended, incoming consent not transferred; explicit second enrollment; work rows unchanged

checks.revocation: Real client owner form revokes enrolled incoming mandate

checks.invitation: Actual queued invitation, synthetic worker-failure state; retry visible, acceptance still pending, no grant and no provider called

checks.denial: Persisted role removal and module lock clear private metadata
